title.en: Bus Services Industry (Control of Conduct and Activities — Public Bus) Regulations 2026
title.orig: Bus Services Industry (Control of Conduct and Activities — Public Bus) Regulations 2026
title.vi: Quy chế Ngành dịch vụ xe buýt (Kiểm soát hành vi và hoạt động — Xe buýt công cộng) 2026
title.th: ข้อบังคับอุตสาหกรรมบริการรถโดยสาร (การควบคุมความประพฤติและกิจกรรม — รถโดยสารสาธารณะ) 2026

title.ms: Peraturan Industri Perkhidmatan Bas (Kawalan Tingkah Laku dan Aktiviti — Bas Awam) 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 19 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Bus Services Industry (Control of Conduct and Activities — Public Bus) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 23 September 2026.

chapter.en: PART 2 CONDITIONS OF USE OF PUBLIC BUS

heading.en: Conditions of use of public bus

text.en:
3. A bus passenger —
(a)must not be in an intoxicated or drugged state;
(b)must not be in a condition such that the bus passenger’s dress or clothing is likely to —
(i)soil or damage the public bus or the dress or clothing of another bus passenger of that public bus; or
(ii)cause injury to another bus passenger of that public bus; and
(c)must comply with regulations 5 to 19,
(called in these Regulations conditions of use).

chapter.en: PART 2 CONDITIONS OF USE OF PUBLIC BUS

heading.en: Directions for breach of conditions of use

text.en:
4.—(1) This regulation applies if —
(a)a bus passenger fails to comply with any condition of use; or
(b)where a bus passenger is boarding, or about to board, a public bus — the bus passenger is likely to fail to comply with a condition of use if allowed to board the public bus.
(2) An authorised person may —
(a)refuse the bus passenger entry to the public bus; or
(b)direct the bus passenger to leave the public bus.
(3) A person who fails to comply with any direction of an authorised person given under paragraph (2) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 PROHIBITED THINGS IN PUBLIC BUS
PART 3 PROHIBITED THINGS IN PUBLIC BUS

heading.en: Bringing mobility vehicles into public bus

chapter.en: PART 3 PROHIBITED THINGS IN PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
7.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), a bus passenger must not bring any animal into, or allow any animal under the bus passenger’s control to remain in, any part of a public bus.
(2) However, the prohibition in paragraph (1) does not apply if —
(a)the animal is a guide dog accompanying a person with a sight or hearing impairment; or
(b)the animal is a dog under the effective control of any police officer in uniform, any member of an auxiliary police force in uniform or any security officer (within the meaning given by section 13 of the Private Security Industry Act 2007) engaged by the LTA or an operator to provide security.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

heading.en: No entry to public bus when bus is full

text.en:
8.—(1) A bus passenger must not —
(a)board or remain in a public bus if an authorised person determines that the public bus is full, and directs that bus passenger not to board or remain in the public bus; or
(b)board a public bus if an automated system installed in the public bus indicates (whether through audio or visual signals) that the public bus is full.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
9.—(1) A bus passenger must not consume, or attempt to consume, any food or drink within a public bus.
(2) To avoid doubt, for the purposes of paragraph (1), food includes chewing gum and bubble gum.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
10.—(1) A bus passenger must not —
(a)place or throw any litter within a public bus; or
(b)soil any part of a public bus, or any fittings, equipment or property within a public bus.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
11.—(1) A bus passenger must not conduct himself or herself within a public bus in a manner that causes, or is likely to cause, nuisance or annoyance to other bus passengers of that public bus.
Examples
1.A bus passenger who places his or her feet, or footwear, on a seat of the public bus is causing annoyance to other bus passengers of that public bus.
2.A bus passenger who uses any mobile phone, wireless handheld device (such as a tablet computer) or wearable device (such as a smart watch) which produces a loud sound that may be heard by one or more other bus passengers, is causing annoyance to other bus passengers of that public bus.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

heading.en: Use, etc., of upper deck of double‑decked public bus

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
13.—(1) A bus passenger must not, without reasonable excuse, obstruct, hinder or impede the movement of another bus passenger within a public bus.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
14.—(1) A bus passenger must not —
(a)intentionally cause any bodily pain or infirmity, or intentionally spread any disease, to any other person within a public bus; or
(b)cause any bodily pain or infirmity, or spread any disease, to any other person within a public bus if the bus passenger knows, or ought reasonably to know, that he or she is likely to cause bodily pain or infirmity, or spread that disease, to that other person.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
15.—(1) A bus passenger, while within a public bus, must not —
(a)tout or solicit alms, rewards or employment of any description;
(b)sell or offer for sale any article or goods, or carry on any business;
(c)display, exhibit or distribute any book or printed, written or pictorial matter or any such samples for the purpose of advertising or publicity; or
(d)provide any public entertainment (within the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Public Entertainments Act 1958).
(2) However, paragraph (1) does not apply to a bus passenger if the bus passenger has the written permission of the LTA or the operator to carry out the activity mentioned in that paragraph.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,000.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
16.—(1) A bus passenger must not enter —
(a)any restricted area within a public bus; or
(b)the driver’s cabin of a public bus.
(2) In this regulation, “restricted area” means any part of a public bus that is demarcated by the LTA or the operator to be inaccessible to any person other than persons authorised by the LTA or the operator.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
17.—(1) A bus passenger must not —
(a)touch, use, meddle or otherwise interfere with any door or any other mechanical or electrical equipment or installation of a public bus;
(b)touch, use, meddle or otherwise interfere with any switch, lever or other device operating or controlling any equipment or installation mentioned in sub‑paragraph (a); or
(c)activate or use any emergency or safety device installed within a public bus.
(2) However, paragraph (1) does not apply to a bus passenger if —
(a)the bus passenger is responding to an emergency and is acting according to instructions mentioned in any notice displayed by the LTA or the operator within the public bus;
(b)the bus passenger is an officer or employee of the LTA, or an employee of the operator, and is acting in the discharge of his or her duties; or
(c)the bus passenger activates or uses the emergency or safety device mentioned in paragraph (1)(c) for the purpose for which the device is provided and in accordance with the instructions printed on that device.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

text.en:
18.—(1) A bus passenger must not —
(a)speak to the driver of a public bus when the public bus is in motion unless there is a reasonable cause to do so;
(b)engage in any conduct or activity that obstructs, hinders, delays or disrupts, or is likely to obstruct, hinder, delay or disrupt, the operations of a public bus; or
(c)hinder or interfere with or otherwise obstruct the driver of the public bus from performing the driver’s duty.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 4 CONDUCT OF BUS PASSENGER OF PUBLIC BUS

heading.en: Compliance with directions, etc., of authorised person

text.en:
19.—(1) A bus passenger must comply with all reasonable directions and instructions of any authorised person given to —
(a)ensure the safety of that bus passenger or any other bus passenger; or
(b)deal with any emergency or unforeseen circumstances.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.
